pub type Raw
pub mod service_error_code
  pub const HANDLER_ERROR: &str
  pub const INVALID_RESULT: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_VERSION: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_SERVICE: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_METHOD: &str
  pub const WRONG_MODE: &str
  pub const INTERNAL: &str
  pub const INVALID_REQUEST: &str
  pub const CALLER_REFUSED: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_OPERATION: &str
  pub const POLICY_UNAVAILABLE: &str
  pub const FORBIDDEN: &str
  pub const ALL: [&str; 12]
pub const PROFILES: [&str; 5]
pub const VERDICTS: [&str; 8]
pub const WIRE_KINDS: [&str; 9]
pub const CREDENTIAL_CONSUMERS: [&str; 1]
pub const ROUTER_ERROR_CODES: [&str; 6]
pub struct HostAllowance
  hosts: Vec<String>
pub struct PickRequest
  model: String
  fresh: bool
  allowed: Option<HostAllowance>
  profile: String
pub struct Caller
  user_description: String
  path_description: String
pub struct Observation
  caller: Caller
  took_ms: i64
  cache_age_ms: i64
pub struct Alias
  host: String
  name: String
  resident: bool
  servable: bool
  hosted: bool
  profiles: Vec<String>
pub struct Family
  family: String
  names: Vec<Alias>
pub struct ModelsSnapshot
  observation: Observation
  models: Vec<Family>
pub struct HostState
  host: String
  base: String
  up: bool
  why: String
  installed: i64
  resident: Vec<String>
  servable: bool
  hosted: bool
  wire: String
  credential: String
  declared_by: String
  profiles: Vec<String>
  domain: String
pub struct Ask
  at: String
  caller: String
  user: String
  model: String
  family: String
  verdict: String
  host: String
pub struct HostsSnapshot
  observation: Observation
  hosts: Vec<HostState>
  doubled: Vec<String>
  asked: Vec<Ask>
pub struct Decision
  asked: String
  family: String
  verdict: String
  host: String
  model: String
  endpoint: String
  installed_on: Vec<String>
  authorised: Option<HostAllowance>
  withheld: Vec<String>
  loads: i64
  why: String
pub struct PickResult
  observation: Observation
  decision: Decision
pub fn encode(v: &PickRequest) -> Vec<u8>
pub struct Refusal
  word: &'static str
  offset: usize
pub fn decode(data: &[u8]) -> Result<PickRequest, Refusal>
pub use abstraction_frame::FrameTransport
pub struct ServiceError
  code: String
  message: String
pub enum CallError<E>
  Transport(E)
  Refusal(Refusal)
  Dispatch(&'static str)
  Service(ServiceError)
pub trait Router
  type Error
  fn models(&self, fresh: bool) -> Result<ModelsSnapshot, Self::Error>
  fn hosts(&self, fresh: bool) -> Result<HostsSnapshot, Self::Error>
  fn pick(&self, request: PickRequest) -> Result<PickResult, Self::Error>
pub struct RouterClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub mod internal
  pub fn micros_timestamp(text: &str) -> bool
  pub fn wide_timestamp(text: &str) -> bool
